description: This file manages Discord account configurations, including resolving account details, creating action gates, and listing enabled accounts within the OpenClaw plugin SDK.

classes.name: ResolvedDiscordAccount
classes.description: Type representing a resolved Discord account with its configuration and status.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Discord account configuration for a given account ID from the overall config.

methods.name: mergeDiscordAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges the Discord account configuration with defaults and partials.

methods.name: createDiscordActionGate
methods.description: Creates an action gate function for Discord actions based on account ID and config.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAccount
methods.description: Resolves a full Discord account object including enabled status, token, and config.

methods.name: resolveDiscordMaxLinesPerMessage
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of lines per message for a Discord account.

methods.name: listEnabledDiscordAccounts
methods.description: Lists all enabled Discord accounts based on the current configuration.
